---
title: "Simulation and digital-twin environments"
description: "Physics-based models of our vehicles, used to test control before water time."
---

We build physics-based models of our vehicles and use simulation to develop and test controllers before hardware trials. The glider control result on this site comes from such a simulation.

*This platform supports our research program in [Simulation and digital twins](../research.qmd#simulation-digital-twins).*
